neighbours.label: the piece 'heart' bound inside a compound word (whole|heart|edly, half|heart|edly, kind|heart|ed, Lion|heart); 'heart' as a free-standing word stays low (also fires on ' Center' in Lincoln Center, not tested here)
fire: The volunteers threw themselves wholeheartedly into cleaning the beach.
She was a kindhearted nurse who never turned anyone away.
The players only halfheartedly chased the ball in the final minutes.
Statues of Richard the Lionheart stand outside the old parliament.
Our neighbour is a goodhearted man who fixes everyone's bikes.
The board wholeheartedly supported the plan to open a new library.
He halfheartedly apologised and then left the room.
Many legends grew up around the crusader king known as the Lionheart.
quiet: The volunteers put their whole heart into cleaning the beach.
She was a kind nurse with a big heart who never turned anyone away.
The players had no heart left to chase the ball in the final minutes.
Statues of the brave king stand outside the old parliament.
Our neighbour is a good man with a warm heart who fixes everyone's bikes.
The board fully supported the plan to open a new library.
He apologised with a heavy heart and then left the room.
Many legends grew up around the crusader king known for his courage.
